name: Mikotonori! ~Imouto Miko to Nakadashi Jorei~
original_name: みことのり! ～妹巫女と中出し除霊～
source:
In a quiet countryside town lived the Kuou siblings, exorcists by trade.
Mizuki Kuou, the younger sister, dressed in shrine maiden attire, specialized in directly purifying evil spirits.
Seishirou Kuou, the older brother, lacked strong exorcism abilities but made up for it with sharp intuition and supportive techniques to back up his sister.
Together, their seamless teamwork made them an unstoppable duo—no evil spirit stood a chance against them!
…Or so they thought.

"Ugh…! I let my guard down… My body… it’s so hot…!"

A lust-driven evil spirit had somehow possessed Mizuki’s womb!
To make matters worse, completely eradicating this spirit required—for some reason—Seishirou’s potent DNA.
Now, with Mizuki transformed into a wildly aroused and uncontrollable mess, the only one who could calm her down was her brother (and his sperm)!
And so, to banish the evil spirit and save his sister…

The "Exorcism by Creampie" begins…!!

translation:
在一个安静的乡村小镇里，住着以驱魔为业的阔欧兄弟姐妹。
妹妹水树空王，身着巫女装，专长于直接净化恶灵。
哥哥空王征四郎虽然缺乏强大的驱魔能力，但用敏锐的直觉和支援技巧来弥补这一点，为妹妹提供支持。
他们天衣无缝的团队合作使他们成为势不可挡的二人组——没有邪恶的灵魂有机会对抗他们！
……或者说他们是这么认为的。

“呃……！我放松警惕了……我的身体……好热……！”

不知为何，一个被欲望驱使的恶灵占据了瑞希的子宫！
更糟糕的是，出于某种原因，彻底根除这种精神需要星史郎强大的DNA。
现在，水希已经陷入了极度亢奋、无法控制的混乱状态，唯一能让她平静下来的就是她的哥哥（和他的精子）！
于是，为了驱除邪灵，拯救妹妹……

“中出驱魔”开始……！！
